title: Power Automate: time and cost savings rules for desktop flows
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap supports its opt-in behaviour and release details, and Microsoft Learn supports both admin paths and Dataverse update operations. Desktop-flow-specific licensing, storage and governance gaps are appropriately distinguished from documentation for cloud flows and agents.
